why exactly 72?

Lay out the 12-tone scale from the tonic, western-style: C D♭ D E♭ E F F♯ G A♭ A B♭ B. A melakarta scale is one specific way of choosing 7 of these 12 tones, under four rules — and multiplying out the independent choices gives exactly 72.

C · Gthe tonic (Sa) and perfect fifth (Pa) — always present, no choice involved
D♭ D E♭ Epick 2 of these 4 — the 2nd and 3rd (Ri and Ga)6 ways
F · F♯pick 1 of these 2 — the 4th (Ma)2 ways
A♭ A B♭ Bpick 2 of these 4 — the 6th and 7th (Da and Ni)6 ways

Every raga above is really a label for one specific choice from this recipe — and the katapayadi cipher is what lets its name also encode which of the 72 it is.
